name: player_keeptradecut_value as_of_month_day derives each per-offset boundary from the MM-DD anchor (executed-result parity)
description: The bespoke main_select_string_year_offset_range emits its own correlated subquery per offset rather than reading the join, so it needs the param wired independently -- and it is where a NaN interpolation defect already shipped once. Requests as_of_month_day 03-01 with year 2023 and year_offset [0,1], so the two per-offset boundaries are make_date(2023+0,3,1) and make_date(2023+1,3,1). Seeds one observation inside each offset's 30-day window (2023-02-25 at 1000 and 2024-02-25 at 2000) plus a decoy at 2023-09-15 that neither window reaches, and the AVG must be 1500. The oracle re-derives the average through an independent value threshold rather than the date-window logic. Goes red when the year_offset term is dropped from the boundary: both offsets then resolve 2023-03-01, both pick 1000, and the average is 1000. Goes red when the anchor year's nfl_games row is removed, because `FROM opening_days od_o WHERE od_o.year = 2023` still drives the subselect even though the boundary no longer reads opening_day -- an anchor year with no opening_days row yields NULL for every offset. The REFRESH is required for exactly that reason.

expected_query: select "player"."pid", player.first_name, player.last_name, (SELECT AVG(offset_value) FROM opening_days od_o CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ((SELECT ktc_o.keeptradecut_value FROM keeptradecut_valuations ktc_o WHERE ktc_o.pid = player.pid AND ktc_o.is_superflex = true AND ktc_o.keeptradecut_value IS NOT NULL AND ktc_o.observed_at <= LEAST(make_date((od_o.year) + 0, 3, 1) + (1 - 1) * interval '1 day', make_date((od_o.year) + 0, 3, 1) + interval '1 month' - interval '1 day')::timestamptz AND ktc_o.observed_at > (LEAST(make_date((od_o.year) + 0, 3, 1) + (1 - 1) * interval '1 day', make_date((od_o.year) + 0, 3, 1) + interval '1 month' - interval '1 day')::timestamptz - interval '30 days') ORDER BY ktc_o.observed_at DESC LIMIT 1)), ((SELECT ktc_o.keeptradecut_value FROM keeptradecut_valuations ktc_o WHERE ktc_o.pid = player.pid AND ktc_o.is_superflex = true AND ktc_o.keeptradecut_value IS NOT NULL AND ktc_o.observed_at <= LEAST(make_date((od_o.year) + 1, 3, 1) + (1 - 1) * interval '1 day', make_date((od_o.year) + 1, 3, 1) + interval '1 month' - interval '1 day')::timestamptz AND ktc_o.observed_at > (LEAST(make_date((od_o.year) + 1, 3, 1) + (1 - 1) * interval '1 day', make_date((od_o.year) + 1, 3, 1) + interval '1 month' - interval '1 day')::timestamptz - interval '30 days') ORDER BY ktc_o.observed_at DESC LIMIT 1))) AS offsets(offset_value) WHERE od_o.year = 2023) AS "player_keeptradecut_value_0", "player"."primary_position" from "player" where player.primary_position IN ('MLB') group by player.first_name, player.last_name, "player"."pid", "player"."last_name", "player"."first_name", "player"."primary_position" order by "player"."pid" asc limit 500
